# U-channel push-on edge trim for sheet steel

| ID | `u-channel-edge-trim` |

Flexible push-on trim with a metal grip insert, sold by the metre. It covers the cut
edge of a sheet-steel opening so it can't cut cables, fingers or the foam lining.
Pick a profile whose grip range covers the measured panel steel thickness and that
bends to the cutout radius.
